## What's included

- Read-only diagnostics for Windows, PowerShell, Codex CLI/Desktop, PATH, WSL, archive tools, developer tools, long paths, and filesystem write access.
- Human-readable console output, JSON, and redacted Markdown issue reports.
- PowerShell 5.1 and 7 test coverage, static analysis, privacy tests, and cleanup verification.

## How to try it

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/cuijialin8888-code/codex-win-doctor.git
cd codex-win-doctor
.\codex-doctor.ps1
```

## Known limitations

- Diagnostics report findings but do not repair PATH, AppX/MSIX, WSL, registry, or security policy.
- Localized Windows/WSL error text can produce `UNKNOWN` when evidence is insufficient.
- AppX/MSIX detection is limited to packages visible to the current user without elevation.
- PowerShell Gallery is used only by contributors and CI for test tooling; it is not a runtime dependency.

## Report issues

Run `.\codex-doctor.ps1 -IssueReport`, review the output, and open a bug or diagnostic request. Never post API keys, tokens, cookies, or credentials.

This project is an independent community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.
